setting.utilitysuite.combat_assistant.hi: Auto: open and re-engage with a sprint knockback hit, keep combos with knockback, crit when knockback is worth little (cornered or eating target, out-damaged, a big mob), sweep only when two or more hostiles stand together and nothing else is in reach of the sweep. Knockback, Crits or Plain force one kind.
setting.utilitysuite.combat_assistant.du: Never run from the fight or drop it when the target gets far or out of sight while it is alive and loaded: back off, heal and come back instead. For closed arenas and boss rooms.
